row.evidence: Coursera's compare-plans page lists "Single sign-on, API and partner integration" only on the Enterprise (500+ users, Contact sales) card; no Coursera page, API spec or IdP listing documents SCIM provisioning.
row.notes: Status changed gated -> unknown. The June row said the Teams plan includes SCIM at $399/user/year, but that came from parent-agent notes, and no first-party source backs it, so it is dropped. Coursera's compare-plans matrix gives SSO and API integrations to Enterprise only, not Team, and the FAQ says Enterprise integrations cost extra (c1, c2). No SCIM documentation exists on coursera.org/business, in the Coursera Business API OpenAPI spec on dev.coursera.com, or on Okta's Coursera app. Okta's app is marked SAML and SWA only, last updated Sep 2020. The Coursera admin help centre (coursera.support) is a Salesforce site that would not render, so this is unknown, not none. Team is $399 per user per year, billed annually. The figure renders client-side on compare-plans; business/pricing serves an empty shell. The Business API (api.coursera.com/ent) can list, update and delete org users and manage program invitations and memberships, so licence lifecycle can be scripted on Enterprise.

plans.name: Team
plans.price_text: $399 per user/year, billed annually (up to 499 users)
plans.notes: The $399 price is rendered client-side on the compare-plans card. The page data marks the Team column without single-sign-on-sso or api-integrations.

auth.notes: Bearer token obtained from Coursera's OAuth generate-token endpoint (separate 'OAuth Credentials' API product on the portal).

capabilities.notes: assign_licenses means adding users to or removing them from a learning program (memberships and invitations), which is how Coursera seats are granted.

endpoints.purpose: Get all users for an organization
Update or delete organization user by email
Delete a user from all programs
Update user data in organization program
Get list of all memberships in a program
Create a program membership for the user
Check whether user is in a program
Get list of invitations in a program
Invite a single user to a program
Invite multiple users to a program

limitations.text: User update and delete go through POST /users with an action of updateByEmail or deleteByEmail. Deletion can be limited to invitations, or soft-delete program memberships.

okta.notes: Okta's page marks SAML and SWA as the supported functionality. SCIM and the provisioning features are unchecked (read from the page markup). Last updated Sep. 2 2020.

entra.notes: No Coursera tutorial in the Microsoft Learn SaaS app tutorial index.

fallbacks.other_sync: LMS/LXP integrations (Workday, Degreed, SAP SuccessFactors and others) and the Coursera Business API for program memberships and invitations
